result.summary: The page layout is largely intact, but there is a text truncation issue with a restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' section that is not due to normal edge-of-screen clipping.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section appears to be cut off mid-word, but it's not clear if this is due to edge clipping or truncation without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses an ellipsis (...) if the name is intentionally shortened due to space constraints, so it's clear to users the text is truncated.
